login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your Airlink account (Microsoft 365) or a local account.
login.totpHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.entra: Microsoft sign-in failed. Please try again.
errors.disabled: Your account is disabled. Contact IT.

selectPanel.title: Where to?
selectPanel.subtitle: Your account can open these panels.
selectPanel.empty: Your account has no role yet. Ask IT or Security to assign one.

devicesPage.title: Kiosk devices
devicesPage.intro: Each security tablet or PC is enrolled once with a code. Afterwards guards sign in with their PIN.
devicesPage.name: Device name
devicesPage.codeHelp: Type it on the kiosk at /guard. Valid for 15 minutes, single use.

membersPage.title: Users and roles
membersPage.intro: Employees sign in with Microsoft; roles are assigned here. Security staff can get an initial kiosk PIN.
membersPage.name: Name
membersPage.pin: Initial kiosk PIN (4 to 8 digits, optional)

errors.pin: The PIN must have 4 to 8 digits.
errors.exists: That user already has that role at that site.

common.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.

sitesPage.title: Sites
sitesPage.intro: Each plant is a site with its gates, areas and policies. Single-site admins only see their own.
sitesPage.name: Site name
sitesPage.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Cannot be changed later.
sitesPage.unannouncedTimeoutMin: Minutes to wait before escalating an unannounced visit
sitesPage.noGates: No gates. Add at least one to enroll kiosks.

errors.exists: A site with that identifier already exists.
errors.areaExists: An area with that name already exists at this site.

policiesPage.title: Visit policies
policiesPage.intro: Rules per site and visit kind. Applied when passes are created and when visitors are validated at reception.

companiesPage.title: Companies
companiesPage.intro: Vendors, contractors, clients and carriers that visit the plants. Companies are shared by every site.
companiesPage.name: Company name

errors.exists: A company with that name already exists.

blacklistPage.title: Blacklist
blacklistPage.intro: Banned people or vehicles. The ID number is never stored in full: only a hash and the last 4 digits.
blacklistPage.valueHelp: ID with or without dashes, passport or plate.
blacklistPage.name: Name (optional)

errors.value: Enter a valid document number or plate.
errors.exists: That entry is already on the blacklist.

employeesPage.title: Employee directory
employeesPage.intro: Hosts who can receive visitors. Synced from SPN and Microsoft; add or fix manual entries here.
employeesPage.results: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# employee} other {# employees}}
employeesPage.name: Name
employeesPage.syncedNote: Synced: the next sync overwrites name, department and extension.

errors.exists: An employee with that email already exists.
errors.synced: Only manual employees can be edited.

enroll.title: Enroll this device
enroll.intro: Ask IT for an enrollment code and type it here.

pin.title: Sign in with PIN
pin.noGuards: No security staff with a PIN at this site. Ask IT to set one up.
pin.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.

host.title: My visits
host.intro: Invite visitors and approve unannounced arrivals from here.

password.title: Password
password.wrong: The current password is not correct.

pin.title: Kiosk PIN
pin.help: Used on the security tablets. 4 to 8 digits.
pin.invalid: The PIN must have 4 to 8 digits.

totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.uri: Add this key to your authenticator app (Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator) and confirm with a code.

visitor.title: Visitor pass
visitor.instructions: Show this pass and your ID at security when you arrive.
visitor.privacy: Your data is used only for access control. Read the privacy notice.
visitor.qrSoon: The QR code will be available in the next phase.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: Check the link or go back home.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.body: Try again. If it keeps failing, tell IT.
